title: Steno, which offers an AI-powered case transcript analysis tool for legal professionals, raised a $49M Series C led by Savano Capital Partners (Kyt Dotson/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Kyt Dotson / SiliconANGLE: Steno, which offers an AI-powered case transcript analysis tool for legal professionals, raised a $49M Series C led by Savano Capital Partners — Steno Agency Inc., a leader in tech-enabled court reporting and litigation support services, today announced it has raised $49 million …
